home.title: I'm Thanh Nguyen
home.description: I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, a Multimedia Engineering graduate from Hanoi University of Science and Technology. I mainly work with Android and also handle full-stack tasks when needed. My goal is simple: build products that run reliably, are easy to maintain, and solve real problems with clear user experience.

about.title: About me
about.personalDescription:
I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, an Android / Full-stack developer. I've worked on Android apps using Kotlin, built applications with Flutter, and developed web systems with React and Node.js. I also build lightweight services with Python/Flask when needed. In addition, I have experience with image processing, OCR, and a few Unity prototypes at an experimental level.

In my work, I care about clean architecture, readable code, and systems that are easy to maintain and extend. When facing new problems, I usually aim for simple and solid solutions that can survive long-term production use. I prefer projects with real constraints—performance, logic, or user flow—rather than projects that only look good as demos.

projects.description: Viettel EID/Passport verification app – Android kiosk solution with liveness detection, NFC reading, OCR (MRZ), and payment integration.
A full-stack platform for managing Android-based Face Terminal devices, including real-time device monitoring, access logs, and remote APK updates.
Coffee shop website & mobile app – Full-stack project (React/Node/MySQL + React Native) with user/admin roles, product browsing, and feedback features.

DSoft – A Flutter-based spa & wellness management app covering booking, staff scheduling, inventory, payments, and basic analytics.
More projects are available on my GitHub — feel free to explore.
